name: 快鳍鱼
evolution: 豆丁鱼 → 快鳍鱼 Lv.20 → 龙鱼 Lv.32
description: 额部鼓起突出，中空有气囊，可以自由改变前额的形状，推测可能是借着移动内部空气来产生形状上的变化，潜水能力相当强，甚至可以一边在水下灵活旋转一边发出多变的叫声，呼唤着同伴，吟唱着记忆深处关于化龙的古老歌谣。
descriptionEn: Its forehead bulges out, hollow with an air sac, freely changing its shape; conjectured to move internal air to alter form. Strong diving ability, can spin flexibly underwater while making varied calls, summoning companions and singing ancient songs deep in memory about becoming a dragon.
